paragraphs.text: Jordan Rivera has experience building low-latency services, including a Rust order-routing service at Northwind Logistics that handled 40,000 requests per minute and reduced p99 latency by 35 percent [e4d720f6005a23d7c8bd5c82f909e618, 5df7c26e92cdd33ba9ece04c63b3ffaf].

His technical skills include Rust, PostgreSQL, and AWS, and he has experience with gRPC [5df7c26e92cdd33ba9ece04c63b3ffaf]. Furthermore, he has experience leading a team of four engineers and migrating PostgreSQL from version 12 to 15 without downtime [e4d720f6005a23d7c8bd5c82f909e618].

Jordan Rivera possesses over five years of backend experience, having worked as a Software Engineer from January 2018 to February 2021 [8c9ba4e303a4d637e249b3b04c35a63c] and as a Senior Backend Engineer from March 2021 to June 2024 [e4d720f6005a23d7c8bd5c82f909e618], totaling more than five years of experience.
